data.name: Student Email Account Takeover
data.details:
• Initial indicator: unusual mailbox rules and security alerts.
  • Checkpoint: verify identity and lock sessions.
  • Escalation: refer to campus IT if university account is affected.

data.name: Financial Aid Phishing Link Clicked
data.details:
• Initial indicator: user clicked aid-related phishing email.
  • Checkpoint: immediate password and MFA hygiene steps.
  • Escalation: advise fraud monitoring if payment details were entered.

data.name: Lost Device with Saved Sessions
data.details:
• Initial indicator: lost phone or laptop with active auth sessions.
  • Checkpoint: revoke sessions and remove trusted devices.
  • Escalation: campus safety referral for confirmed theft.

data.name: Social Media Impersonation Attempt
data.details:
• Initial indicator: fake profile requests contacts and money.
  • Checkpoint: report impersonation and preserve screenshots.
  • Escalation: legal/privacy path if doxxing accompanies impersonation.

data.name: Credential Reuse Exposure Alert
data.details:
• Initial indicator: breach notification for reused password.
  • Checkpoint: rotate credentials by criticality and unique passphrases.
  • Escalation: IT helpdesk referral if campus SSO credentials were reused.

data.name: MFA Fatigue Prompt Bombing
data.details:
• Pivot indicator: repeated push prompts while user is inactive.
  • Checkpoint: disable push, move to phishing-resistant method.
  • Escalation: immediate supervisor review for active compromise risk.

data.name: Malicious OAuth App Consent
data.details:
• Pivot indicator: suspicious third-party app token granted.
  • Checkpoint: revoke app tokens and audit connected services.
  • Escalation: IT referral when university tenant scope is involved.

data.name: SIM Swap Suspicion
data.details:
• Pivot indicator: sudden loss of phone service and account reset attempts.
  • Checkpoint: carrier lock and priority account recovery.
  • Escalation: law enforcement recommendation for financial theft indicators.

data.name: Recovery Email Changed
data.details:
• Pivot indicator: account recovery details modified without consent.
  • Checkpoint: identity verification and recovery path hardening.
  • Escalation: critical referral when multiple accounts show takeover.

data.name: Browser Session Cookie Theft
data.details:
• Pivot indicator: login alerts from new geography despite no credential reset.
  • Checkpoint: sign out everywhere and inspect recent extensions.
  • Escalation: refer to IT security if institutional apps were accessed.

data.name: Cloud Drive Data Exfiltration
data.details:
• C2 indicator: mass downloads or share-link creation.
  • Checkpoint: revoke sessions and disable suspicious sharing.
  • Escalation: privacy/legal routing when sensitive records are involved.

data.name: Stealth Auto-Forward to External Mailbox
data.details:
• C2 indicator: hidden forwarding rules to external domains.
  • Checkpoint: remove rules and inspect access history.
  • Escalation: report to IT if university communications are exposed.

data.name: Command Channel via Messaging App
data.details:
• C2 indicator: attacker coordinates extortion via direct messages.
  • Checkpoint: preserve evidence and avoid direct negotiation.
  • Escalation: campus safety and legal supervisor referral as needed.

data.name: Remote Access Tool Beaconing
data.details:
• C2 indicator: unknown remote-control software appears active.
  • Checkpoint: isolate endpoint from networks and reset credentials from clean device.
  • Escalation: IT support referral for endpoint remediation.

data.name: New MFA Device Added by Attacker
data.details:
• Persistence indicator: unrecognized authenticator enrollment.
  • Checkpoint: remove unknown factors and enforce new enrollment.
  • Escalation: supervisor review for potential coordinated takeover.

data.name: App Password Created for Legacy Access
data.details:
• Persistence indicator: app password generated without user intent.
  • Checkpoint: revoke app passwords and review mailbox access logs.
  • Escalation: IT referral when institutional identity provider is impacted.

data.name: Trusted Device Added
data.details:
• Persistence indicator: unknown trusted device bypasses checks.
  • Checkpoint: clear trusted devices and force reauthentication.
  • Escalation: supervisor review if repeated persistence attempts continue.

data.name: Stealth Login Rule Survives Reset
data.details:
• Persistence indicator: suspicious behavior continues after password reset.
  • Checkpoint: full account control audit and session invalidation.
  • Escalation: production SOC referral if enterprise controls are bypassed.

data.name: Identity Verification Intake
data.details:
• Confirm requester identity through approved channel before guidance.
  • Record severity and immediate safety concerns.

data.name: Account Recovery Checklist
data.details:
• Recover primary account first, then cascade to linked accounts.
  • Prioritize email, identity provider, and financial platforms.

data.name: Revoke All Sessions
data.details:
• Sign out all sessions across major accounts from a known-clean device.
  • Re-check alerts after forced reauth.

data.name: MFA Hardening Procedure
data.details:
• Replace weak MFA methods with phishing-resistant options where possible.
  • Disable push approvals during active attack.

data.name: Unique Passphrase Reset Plan
data.details:
• Generate unique passphrases for high-priority accounts first.
  • Use a password manager workflow if available.

data.name: Mailbox Rule and Delegate Audit
data.details:
• Inspect forwarding rules, delegates, and signatures for tampering.
  • Remove unknown rules and preserve audit screenshots.

data.name: Connected Apps Token Review
data.details:
• Revoke unknown OAuth app tokens and stale integrations.
  • Reauthorize only trusted applications.

data.name: Evidence Timeline Builder
data.details:
• Capture key timestamps, alerts, and actions in sequence.
  • Use timeline for clean escalation handoff.

data.name: Victim-Centered Communication
data.details:
• Use clear language and avoid blame.
  • State what to do now, next, and who to contact.

data.name: Escalation Handoff Template
data.details:
• Document severity, impact, actions taken, and unresolved risk.
  • Provide concise handoff to supervisor or designated office.

data.name: Caller Reports Active Extortion Message
data.details:
• Inject effect: immediate severity increase.
  • Decision checkpoint: campus safety referral language.

data.name: Parent or Guardian Calls in Panic
data.details:
• Inject effect: communications complexity rises.
  • Decision checkpoint: verify authority before disclosing details.

data.name: Student Reveals Reused Password on Banking App
data.details:
• Inject effect: financial risk introduced.
  • Decision checkpoint: prioritize financial account protection guidance.

data.name: Unexpected Login from Another Country
data.details:
• Inject effect: threat confidence rises to confirmed compromise.
  • Decision checkpoint: escalate severity and trigger recovery sequence.

data.name: University SSO Also Shows Suspicious Access
data.details:
• Inject effect: institutional impact appears.
  • Decision checkpoint: mandatory referral to IT helpdesk and SOC.

data.name: Caller Mentions Doxxing and Stalking Threats
data.details:
• Inject effect: safety concerns become primary.
  • Decision checkpoint: campus safety referral and evidence preservation guidance.

data.name: Fraud Alert on Linked Payment Method
data.details:
• Inject effect: account compromise has financial consequences.
  • Decision checkpoint: direct to bank fraud workflows and identity protections.

data.name: Critical Coursework Locked by Account Loss
data.details:
• Inject effect: urgency and impact increase.
  • Decision checkpoint: prioritize account recovery path and service referrals.
